name: Universita della Svizzera italiana
summary: Italian-speaking university in Lugano; Informatics and Data Science are taught in English, and Economics has an English track.

ib.text: swissuniversities IB rule: 32/42 (2026/27), six subjects, three HL incl. maths or a science; Psychology, ESS, Global Politics and the arts don't count. Communication and Philosophy also need Italian.

dates.label: Application deadline for EU/EFTA and Swiss applicants who need no visa

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Informatics
programmes.about: Software design and architecture, modelling of complex systems and systems thinking, with theory paired with sizeable projects and lab work, an internship and a bachelor project, in a faculty founded in 2004.

needs.note: One of your three HL subjects must be maths or a science (biology, chemistry or physics).

programmes.selectionNote: No selection and no entrance exam: every applicant who meets the swissuniversities IB rule is admitted. 2026/27 rule; 2027/28 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Data Science
programmes.about: Statistics, mathematics and programming applied to real domains, run jointly by the informatics and economics faculties, with a stream in Informatics or in Finance and Economics.

needs.note: One of your three HL subjects must be maths or a science (biology, chemistry or physics).

programmes.selectionNote: No selection and no entrance exam: every applicant who meets the swissuniversities IB rule is admitted. 2026/27 rule; 2027/28 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Economics (English track)
programmes.ib: English core stream: an English B2 certificate (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 70, Cambridge First C) or USI's own test in the first four weeks, unless your school taught in English.
programmes.about: Management, finance, micro- and macroeconomics, quantitative methods and law in a common core taught in English or Italian, then a specialisation in management, finance, political economy or quantitative methods.

needs.note: One of your three HL subjects must be maths or a science (biology, chemistry or physics).

programmes.selectionNote: Every eligible applicant is admitted; the 190-place cap with a waiting list (2026/27) applies to the Italian-language stream.

notes: EU/EFTA applicants who need no visa can apply until 30 June 2027, two months after the non-EU deadline.
In Economics the first three semesters run in both Italian and English, and USI still names Italian as the degree's official teaching language.
Data Science is run jointly by the Informatics and Economics faculties, with streams in Informatics or Finance and Economics.
